content: अर्ध (Written also as अर्द्ध)¦ {%a.%} [ऋध्-णिच्-अच्; according to <ls>Nir.</ls> from धृ, or ऋध्] Half, forming a half (divided into 2 parts); अर्ध-अर्ध the one half-the other half. .{@-र्धः@} [ऋध्-घञ्] .²1 A place, region, country; house, habitation (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²2 Increase (वृद्धि). .²3 Wind. .²4 A part, portion, side. .{@-र्धम्, -र्धः@} .²1 A half, half portion; पचाति नेमो न हि पक्षदर्धः <ls>Rv. 10. 27. 18</ls>. सर्वनाशे समुत्पन्ने अर्धं त्यजति पण्डितः; गतमर्धं दिवसस्य <ls>V. 2</ls>; पूर्वार्धः first half; so उत्तर˚ latter half; दक्षिण˚ southern half (half on the right side); so अवर˚, जघन˚, पर˚, ग्राम˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; यदर्धे विच्छिन्नम् <ls>Ś. 1. 9</ls> divided in half; ऋज्वायतार्धम् <ls>M. 27</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 59</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 99</ls>; रात्रौ तदर्धं गतम् <ls>Bh. 3. 107</ls>; one part of two, apart, partly (<ab>Ved.</ab>); .²2 Nearness, proximity; see अर्धदेव. (अर्ध may be compounded with almost every noun and adjective; as first member of compound with nouns it means ‘a half of’ and forms an एकदेशिसमास or तत्पुरुष; ˚कायः = अर्धं कायस्य; ˚पिप्पली, ˚मार्गः; ˚पुरुषः <ab>&c.</ab>; with adjectives, it has an adverbial force; ˚श्याम half dark; ˚भुक्त half eaten; so ˚पिष्ट, ˚पूर्ण <ab>&c.</ab>; with numeral adjectives it may mean either ‘a half of’ or ‘with an additional half’; ˚शतम् half of 100 {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} 50; or अर्धेन सहितं शतम् {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} 150; with ordinal numerals ‘with a half or that number’; ˚तृतीयम् containing two and the third only half; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} two and a half; so ˚चतुर्थ three and a half. <ab>cf.</ab> अर्धं खण्डे समांशके <ls>Nm.</ls>)
